fields.description: Digits only, without +. Applied to local numbers stored without a country code (e.g. 9087652245 becomes +919087652245).
fields.label: Default Country Code

fields.description: All Records: every salesperson can search all customers and leads. Own Records: only customers/leads they own or have activities on.
fields.label: Customer Visibility

fields.description: Salespeople always see only their own activities in the app. Tick this to also hide other employees' CRM Tasks from Hipersign Sales users who additionally have the Sales User role (Desk / CRM UI / REST). Managers are never restricted.
fields.label: Restrict Task Visibility

fields.description: Used when an activity has no end time.
fields.label: Default Activity Duration (Minutes)

fields.description: Sends reminders, assignments and changes to phones through Firebase.
fields.label: Enable Push Notifications

fields.description: Firebase console > Project settings > Service accounts > Generate new private key. Upload the downloaded .json file here (keep it Private). It never leaves the server.
fields.label: Firebase Service Account Key (JSON)

fields.description: Reminders show the customer, the follow-up title and its notes. Untick to show only the time (details stay hidden on the lock screen; they open in the app).
fields.label: Show Customer and Notes in Notifications

fields.description: When ticked, the Android app offers new builds from GitHub as an in-app update.
fields.label: Enable In-App Updates

fields.description: Fine-grained GitHub token with read-only Contents access to the app repository. Stored encrypted.
fields.label: GitHub Token

fields.description: Calls made from the app are matched with the phone's own call recording and uploaded here, linked to the customer / lead and the activity. The phone's built-in call recorder must be switched on.
fields.label: Enable Call Recordings

fields.description: When a salesperson dials a number that is not in ERPNext, the business name is looked up on Google Maps and a CRM Lead is created for the call. Uses the Google Places API (New) - Google charges per lookup after the monthly free usage. Each number is looked up at most once a week.
fields.label: Look Up Unknown Numbers On Google

fields.description: From Google Cloud Console with Places API (New) enabled. Stored encrypted; never sent to phones.
fields.label: Google Maps API Key

fields.description: CRM Lead Source set on leads created from Google. Leave empty to use "Google Maps" (created automatically).
fields.label: Lead Source For New Leads

fields.description: Salespeople can book a trial with any trainer at any free time inside her shift - no need to create Trainer Slots by hand. The shift comes from the trainer's Employee record (active Shift Assignment, else Default Shift); holidays and approved leave are days off. She is busy during the lunch break, a trial already booked, or an open follow-up / meeting assigned to her. The hours below are used only for trainers without a shift.
fields.label: Trainers Are Free During Their Shift

fields.description: Comma separated: Mon,Tue,Wed,Thu,Fri,Sat,Sun. Used when the trainer has no Holiday List.
fields.label: Working Days

fields.description: Nobody is offered for trials during the break. A shift can have its own break (Shift Type > Lunch Break From / To).
fields.label: Lunch Break From

fields.description: Multi-day trials count only working days: Sundays and the holidays in this list are skipped (the end date moves later). Empty = the default company's holiday list.
fields.label: Holiday List For Trial Days

fields.description: Sends an approved WhatsApp template through the Frappe WhatsApp app (WhatsApp Account must be set up there) after a salesperson's call or when a new lead is created. Every message is saved as a WhatsApp Message, linked to the customer / lead / deal.
fields.label: Send Automatic WhatsApp Messages

fields.description: Parameters: one value per {{1}}, {{2}}... of the template, separated by commas. Use {name}, {first_name}, {salesperson}, {salesperson_phone}, {phone}, {company}, {date}, {time} or plain text. Leave empty to fill every parameter with the customer's name.
fields.label: WhatsApp Rules

fields.description: Default for new development tasks, comma separated, e.g. 1440,60 = a day before and an hour before. Each task can have its own.
fields.label: Remind Developers Before Deadline (Minutes)

fields.description: Every morning at this time, the developer and whoever assigned it are alerted about each development task that is past its deadline and not done.
fields.label: Daily Overdue Alert At

fields.default:
Accounts
Marketing
Hiring
Sales
Operations
Other
fields.description: One per line. Shown when assigning a task in the app (accounts, marketing, hiring...). Reminders and overdue alerts work like development tasks.
fields.label: Teams

fields.description: At the time below, every employee gets their day's report in the app: work that was due that day (follow-ups, meetings, trials / trainings, tasks, development) - done and not done - and calls made. Managers get everyone's. The report is also saved here as Hipersign Daily Report.
fields.label: Send Daily Work Report

fields.description: New quotations in the app start with this company (it can still be changed there). Empty = the company the person used last time.
fields.label: Default Company For Quotations

fields.description: Salespeople read and answer customers' WhatsApp messages in the app: text replies, approved templates, photos, documents and voice messages. They see the chats of their own customers / leads / deals and of numbers not in ERPNext yet; managers see all chats (with Customer Visibility = All Records everyone sees all). A new message notifies the owner of that customer / lead / deal, or everyone who can see the chat when nobody owns it.
fields.label: Show WhatsApp Chats In The App

fields.description: WhatsApp limits: photos 5 MB, voice / video 16 MB, documents 100 MB.
fields.label: Max Photo / File Size (MB)
